title: Monthly Exposure Measure in the C&I Anniversary Security Review
content:
**§ Anniversary security review: measuring the monthly exposure** - Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts

The review's monthly exposure depends on how many billed cycles were posted in the review window:

- **12 or more cycles:** the window's net charges (supply lines plus rebill credits posted in the window) divided by the cycles counted;
- **3 to 11 cycles, at least one of them posted in the latest three months:** the net charges posted in the latest three months divided by the cycles posted in those three months;
- **any other count** (fewer than 3 cycles, or none in the latest three months): the reference exposure, being the kWh posted on the contract's supply lines in the review window multiplied by the structure's deposit reference rate in cents per kWh, divided by 100 and by 12 months per year.

## Terms used

- **Review window:** the twelve months before the handling date, by the posted date of each line. A line falls in the twelve months before the handling date when it was posted on or before the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from its posted date to the handling date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date. The latest three months are counted the same way with three whole months.
- **Cycles** are counted once each: by the energy charge line; on a block and index contract, by the block energy charge line, the index energy charge lines then not being counted; otherwise by the index energy charge line.
- **Net charges** are the amounts of the supply lines (energy, block energy, index energy, capacity and transmission charge lines) posted in the period plus the rebill credits posted in it, the credits being negative.

| Structure | Deposit reference rate |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | 9.75 cents per kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | 9.75 cents per kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | 9.75 cents per kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | 9.75 cents per kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | 9.75 cents per kWh |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | 9.75 cents per kWh |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Cycles in the window | In the latest three months | Figures | Monthly exposure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 3 | window net charges $402000.00 | 402000.00 divided by 12: $33500.00 |
| 6 | 2 | latest three months' net charges $61300.00 | 61300.00 divided by 2: $30650.00 |
| 2 | 1 | window kWh 640000 | 640000 multiplied by 9.75, divided by 100 and by 12: $5200.00 |
